def process(extract_predicted_values, load_observed_ap) -> pd.DataFrame:
    forecasted = extract_predicted_values.copy()
    observed = load_observed_ap.copy()
    
    forecasted['date'] = pd.to_datetime(forecasted['date'])
    
    observed_dates = {
        '2025-03-10': 10,
        '2025-03-11': 10,
        '2025-03-12': 32
    }
    
    forecasted['observed_ap'] = forecasted['date'].astype(str).map(observed_dates)
    forecasted['error'] = (forecasted['predicted_ap'] - forecasted['observed_ap']).abs()
    
    mae = forecasted['error'].mean()
    
    result_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'date': forecasted['date'].astype(str),
        'predicted_ap': forecasted['predicted_ap'],
        'observed_ap': forecasted['observed_ap'],
        'absolute_error': forecasted['error'],
        'mae': [mae] * len(forecasted)
    })
    
    return result_df
